translations.web: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
translations.bsb: I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
translations.kjv: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
translations.asv: I will sing of the lovingkindness of Jehovah for ever: With my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
